lines.trans: Hello to you again, good man.
Listen, I wanted to ask your advice.
Come on, calm down first.
I will tell you everything myself right now.
Are you doubting whether to take the money or not?

Take the money and boldly follow him.
He will make you much more money.
Understood everything, thank you so much!
A molecular dinner was ordered to the room.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'советоваться').
